sso.citizen.title.message: How it works for your clients

sso.citizen.subtitle.message: Your users authenticate on your website with their ID card — no password, no form.

sso.step1.description.message: The website shows a QR code. Open EidKit on your phone and scan it.

sso.step2.description.message: Enter the CAN (6 digits on the front of the card) and the 4-digit PIN set at MAI.

sso.step3.description.message: Hold your ID card to the back of your phone. Your identity is cryptographically verified — you're authenticated.

sso.citizen.privacy.message: Shared data (name, date of birth, address) comes directly from the ID card chip, verified by MAI — not entered manually by you. Your CNP is never shared with the website unless explicitly requested.

sso.developer.title.message: Add ID card login to your platform

sso.developer.subtitle.message: EidKit SSO works like any other OIDC provider — same flow as Google Sign-In or Apple Sign-In. Your users authenticate by tapping their card, you receive MAI-verified data.

sso.developer.value1.title.message: One tap = new account or login

sso.developer.value1.body.message: There is no difference between registration and login. The first card tap creates the account automatically — no form, no email, no password.

sso.developer.value2.body.message: Name, date of birth, and address come directly from the ID card chip, cryptographically verified by MAI. You don't depend on what the user types.

sso.developer.value3.title.message: Zero trust — physical card + PIN required

sso.developer.value3.body.message: The server issues no token without cryptographic proof that the user holds the physical card and knows the PIN. Cryptographic binding between identity and chip (Chip Authentication, BSI TR-03110) makes the split-proof attack impossible. No captured password, no screenshot, no cloning can pass the check.

sso.developer.value4.body.message: Client ID, Client Secret, redirect URI — exactly like any other provider. If you've ever integrated Google or GitHub OAuth, you already know everything you need.

sso.developer.cta.text.message: Contact us for access and we'll configure your first OIDC client.

homepage.feature.kyc.description.message: Read identity fields (name, CNP, date of birth), face photo, handwritten signature image, and full address from the EDATA applet — all in one NFC tap.

homepage.feature.signing.description.message: Produce a qualified ECDSA-SHA384 signature using the nonRepudiation key on the card chip. Embed directly into a PAdES/eIDAS PDF or send to your signing service.

homepage.feature.activeauth.description.message: Challenge-response verification that the chip is genuine and has not been cloned. Returns raw cryptographic proof material your backend can independently verify.
